combo_label: At the Seaside × Board Game Night × Shakespeare

entries.clue: Corner square you get sent to, where leaving early costs fifty
Motley-clad court wit licensed to mock the king
Cubes you rattle and then blame when the roll goes badly
Large 1623 collected edition, its sheets each yielding two leaves
Venetian's ensign whose whispered lies breed deadly jealousy
Row of fabric panels on poles, hammered in to shelter the family picnic
Party mat game that becomes an undignified human knot
The leaflet fetched mid-argument to prove your brother wrong
Short-handled digging blade: plastic on the beach, steel in the garden.
Sandcastle mould with a handle, also handy for hauling seawater up the beach.
Quietly move two extra squares and hope nobody was watching
Victorian walkway on iron legs, striding out over the water to a pavilion
Big tilting shade planted in the sand to keep the glare off
